channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: Water leak and ticket fraud charges add to Louvre woes
item.description: After a break-in and strikes, a ticket fraud scandal and a water leak on Friday brought new troubles to France's Louvre museum.

item.title: Inside France: Bardella bloopers, train bores and putting a price on romance
item.description: From the intellectual heft of Jordan Bardella to the latest on the Marine Le Pen trial, via the real price of romance in Paris, Inside France is our weekly look at the latest news and talking points from France.

item.title: French flood alert system working at record pace, chief says
item.description: The flood alert system in France has been working at a record pace as relentless rain over the past month has saturated soils, the head of the agency told AFP on Saturday.

item.title: ECB fines French bank for climate risk failures
item.description: The European Central Bank said Friday it had fined French bank Credit Agricole €7.55 million ($9 million) for failing to properly identify climate change-related risks that could affect its balance sheet.

item.title: Europe, UK seek closer ties a decade after Brexit
item.description: Ten years after the referendum that led to Brexit, Britain and the European Union must close ranks in an increasingly unstable world, their leaders said on Saturday.

item.title: World should 'take cue' from, not criticise Europe, says Macron
item.description: France's President Emmanuel Macron on Friday defended Europe as an example to follow, as the continent seeks to rebuild strained ties with the United States.

item.title: European debate over nuclear weapons gains pace
item.description: European leaders, worried about threats from a nuclear-armed Russia and doubts about the future of US security commitments, are increasingly debating whether to bolster nuclear arsenals on the continent.

item.title: Airlines told to cancel Paris flights on Sunday amid snow warnings in France
item.description: The French civil aviation authority has told airlines to restrict flights in and out of Paris airports on Sunday because of predicted snow and ice.

item.title: French prosecutors to set up special team to review Epstein files
item.description: The Paris prosecutor's office announced on Saturday it was setting up a special team of magistrates to analyse evidence that could implicate French nationals in the crimes of convicted US sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: France's Macron urges calm after right-wing youth fatally beaten
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron called for calm and restraint on Saturday after the fatal beating of a 23-year-old French youth aligned with the far-right on the sidelines of a conference by a hard-left lawmaker in the southeastern city of Lyon.
